rule: development = questions run or inspected in v2/v3 (they exposed the defects, and v3 smoke used Q01,Q04,Q05,Q18). held_out_confirmatory_ml_multitool = Q30,Q31,Q32,Q41,Q42,Q44 (never run, never inspected, carried over from v3). held_out_confirmatory_pdb_lit = Q46-Q51, authored from the database/corpus after v3 and never shown to any model before evaluation. No held-out question may be used to debug prompts, contracts or scoring; protocol smoke tests use development questions only.
smoke_note: protocol smoke questions are development questions (Q01 pdb, Q05 literature, Q18 multi-tool) already exposed in v2/v3
caveat: Database/literature held-out set is small (3+3 questions): per-category intervals are wide and broad claims about general PSC workflow performance are not supported by n=12 held-out questions.
